description: This file is a Smarty plugin defining the function 'sugarvar' used to generate dynamic Smarty template variables for SugarCRM. It includes logic for variable retrieval, error handling, and template string assembly with optional filters.

methods.name: smarty_function_sugarvar
methods.description: Generates a Smarty variable string based on provided parameters, handling object and member retrieval, and appends optional filters for HTML escaping, encoding, and formatting.
